results.title: How much does AI translation cost? DeepL, Google Translate, OpenAI compared (2026) | SimpleLocalize
results.snippet: Marketing pages, onboarding flows, and UI copy that users read carefully benefit from DeepL's quality advantage in supported pairs. Watch out for: The cost is higher than Google NMT for the same character volume, and the free tier is more limited.

results.title: Google Translate API Pricing Calculator (Jun 2026)
results.snippet: Choose based on your cloud ecosystem and language needs. Google Cloud Translation API provides 500,000 characters per month completely free - and unlike Amazon Translate's 12-month limit, Google's free tier never expires.

results.title: Translation API Pricing Comparison (June 2026) | Google Translate vs DeepL
results.snippet: Cache translated content, batch translations, use translation memory for repeated phrases, and only translate user-facing content. At 1M chars/month, Google costs about $10 (after free tier) vs DeepL at $30.49.

results.title: Best translation APIs in 2026: NMT engines, LLMs, and how to choose
results.snippet: Microsoft Translator at $10 per million characters is the lowest-cost major NMT API in 2026. Among LLM APIs, DeepSeek V3 at approximately $0.27 per million input tokens is the most cost-efficient option, though pricing varies by deployment method ...
